summary: A disconnected (bundled) containerized install uses a pre-packaged bundle with all images and dependencies for air-gapped networks; it needs a local RPM repository and no registry credentials or internet.
questions: How do I install containerized AAP in an air-gapped environment?
Do I need registry credentials for a bundled install?
What does the containerized setup bundle require?

answer_card.title: Disconnected (bundled) install requirements
answer_card.answer_md:
- Use the **Containerized Setup Bundle** (all images and dependencies included)
- Needs a local RPM repository with the required dependencies
- No internet needed during install
- No Red Hat registry credentials needed
